") is pleased to report that encouraging results continue to be returned from Phase 1 Roger diamond drilling. The new results, in combination with our Phase 2 definition drilling, will supplement an expanded Mineral Resource for the historical Roger Zone being undertaken.

The new assays continue to demonstrate the two features that define Roger's investment case, exceptional width and consistent grade near surface, punctuated by high-grade gold. Hole AUR-26-07 returned the standout intercept of the program to date, 125.3 m grading 0.67 g/t Au from 346.0 m, including 20.0 m at 1.94 g/t Au, this single intersection extends the Roger zone by at least 125 metres at depth.

Higher in the system, AUR-26-06 cut 34.5 m of 0.69 g/t Au and 0.14% Cu beginning just 70.5 m downhole, including 6.0 m at 1.85 g/t Au and 0.34% Cu, confirming that meaningful copper-gold mineralization starts near surface. AUR-26-05 added 23.5 m of 1.12 g/t Au, including a high-grade interval of 12.2 g/t Au over 1.1 m, while late intercepts of 50.4 g/t Au over 0.5 m at 572.7 m and 9.1 g/t Au over 2.5 m at 596.0 m depth in AUR-26-06 demonstrates that the high-grade gold endowment persists well below the historical resource.

Each hole reported intersected mineralization over broad intervals, the system remains open in all directions, and each of these intercepts falls above the 0.2 g/t Au cut-off being applied to the revised Mineral Resource Estimate, meaning this drilling is not just extending the geology, it is directly adding to the resource base currently being calculated.

"Drilling continues to support our view of a significantly expanded porphyry Cu-Au resource at Roger below and along strike from historical drilling on the property and has confirmed the presence of an overlying gold-rich VMS horizon," said Peter Cashin, Auriginal Mining Corp's CEO. "We are seeing strong mineralization in all holes, which remains open below and to the southwest and northeast of the previous limits of Roger zone. Phase 2 drilling is well underway and is showing some of the strongest sulphide mineralization observed to date."

Phase 1 Drilling Expands Roger Mineralized Footprint

Auriginal's Phase 1 drilling program was designed to test extensions of the historical Roger copper-gold mineralization and further evaluate the Company's geological interpretation of the broader mineralized system. Drilling to date has extended the known porphyry-style mineralization approximately 700 metres southwest and 400 metres northeast of the historical drilling limits, while also extending the depth limits of mineralization by more than 100 metres. The Roger mineralized system remains open in all directions. A total of ten drillholes for 7,325 m were completed in this Phase of the Roger program.

This concentration of substantial gold and copper resources underscores the scale and strategic importance of the mineral district surrounding Roger, providing Auriginal with exposure to a rapidly re-emerging Québec mining camp.
$2.0 Million Phase 2 Definition Drill Program Underway

Following the expansion demonstrated during Phase 1, Auriginal has allocated an additional $2.0 million to Phase 2 definition drilling at Roger. The program is designed to provide sufficient drill density across the newly identified extensions of the Roger mineralized system to support their potential inclusion in a future MRE. Based on PLR's initial review, drilling at approximately 125-metre spacing has been recommended across portions of the newly defined mineralized extensions to support evaluation for potential classification within an Inferred Mineral Resource.

The Company expects the broader resource work incorporating the expanded drilling footprint to follow the October update, with additional resource work tentatively targeted for later in 2026 or early 2027. All currently planned Phase 2 drilling and associated technical work is fully funded.

Auriginal is a Quebec-focused copper and gold company with one of the province's largest and most diversified exploration portfolios. Its 100%-owned flagship Roger Project, located in the Chibougamau district, hosts a known gold-copper deposit with strong potential to host volcanic-hosted polymetallic massive sulphide deposits. With a diversified pipeline of greenfield projects across Quebec's best-known mining regions and backed by the Ore Group's proven exploration and capital markets team Auriginal has a clear focus on discovery and growth for copper, zinc and gold. The company is well-positioned to immediately execute an aggressive exploration and acquisition strategy and attract broader market attention.
